quotes.name: Sandra Velazquez
quotes.quote: I don't usually have seasonal health concerns—I'm pretty careful about staying active and eating right year-round. Maybe the Tribune should ask if this is based on actual doctor visits or just general neighborhood chatter.

quotes.name: Ariana Lee
quotes.quote: I've lived here long enough to know Sandra Velazquez doesn't just get seasonal sniffles—she's the type to power through a flu without missing a beat. The Tribune should ask what changed this year that made it noticeable enough to mention.
